definitions.explanation: A place where hair is cut, styled, colored, or permed. In Japan, distinct from a barbershop.

examples.japanese: {美容室|びようしつ}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the hair salon.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{美容室|びようしつ}がオープンした。
examples.english: A new beauty salon opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{一回|いっかい}{美容室|びようしつ}に{通|かよ}っているが、{今月|こんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しくて{行|い}けなかった。
examples.english: I go to the beauty salon once a month, but this month I was too busy to go.

notes:
Composed of {美容|びよう} (beauty, cosmetics) + {室|しつ} (room). In Japan, {美容室|びようしつ} and {理髪店|りはつてん}/{床屋|とこや} (barbershop) are legally and culturally distinct. {美容室|びようしつ} are licensed to cut and style hair, offer perms and coloring, and serve both men and women. The more casual synonym {美容院|びよういん} is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容室|びようしつ}に{行|い}く: to go to the hair salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}を{予約|よやく}する: to book a salon appointment
- {美容室|びようしつ}に{通|かよ}う: to go regularly to a salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}で{髪|かみ}を{切|き}る: to get a haircut at a salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}で{染|そ}める: to get hair colored at a salon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美容院|びよういん}: beauty salon — virtually synonymous, equally common
- {床屋|とこや}: barbershop — traditionally for men, more casual atmosphere
- {理髪店|りはつてん}: barbershop — formal word for barber
- ヘアサロン: hair salon — loanword, used by trendy or upscale shops
